name: tolerance_on_the_model_dimension
why: ENTRY Z-F2. A Ø10 hole without a tolerance is not manufacturing information: the turner does not know whether a pin or a cable goes in it. Put on the dimension of the MODEL, the tolerance reaches the drawing by itself with model_dimensions. Measured with the little test rig on 26/9/2026: SOLIDWORKS computes the ISO 286 deviations by itself (H7 on 10: 0 / +0.015), and on the drawing it printed them with the decimals of the dimension — «10 H7 +0 / 0».
defect_caught: Three: the tolerance that is not written (the re-reading), the fit with the wrong width (the check against the ISO 286-1 table, independent of SOLIDWORKS), and the decimals of the tolerance at zero, which print «+0/0».

expect.tolerance_why: pi inside: 96000 minus pi x 5^2 x 10

expect.why: the dimension of the hole, not the thickness (which is also 10: the probe had fallen for it)

expect.tolerance_why: SOLIDWORKS writes in metres, here in mm to four decimals
expect.why: an H hole starts from zero
IT7 between 6 and 10 mm is 15 µm (ISO 286-1)
the independent check: the table, not SOLIDWORKS
measured: without it, the drawing showed «+0 / 0» — the limits with the decimals of the dimension
those of the value asked for
